rule_or_pattern: drop every line with width_ratio > 0.8 of the text width on ANY page of this book, including pages whose column count was detected as 1 (e.g. p000005); keep half-width lines
notes: 1879 two-column parliamentary proceedings (dev split). Half-width single-column lines (1-4, 6, 10, 11, 14-19) read correctly in polytonic Greek. Every full-width line is two half-lines from different columns joined across the gutter (7-9, 12, 13, 20, 21, 24-33, 35, 37, 38); in 22, 23, 34, 36, 39 and 40 the crop spans both columns while the label keeps only a short fragment. Line 5 (page p000005, detected as 1 column, width 0.99) is an unflagged merge, so the pool-wide gutter rule would miss pages where the column detector failed; hence the width rule applies to every page.
